description: Minimum test count per tier. A suite that shrinks without explanation is a silently disabled suite — a broken include glob drops the unit tier from 1024 tests to 3 and every other gate still passes, because total > 0, failed === 0 and success === true.
howToRaise: Raise a floor in the same commit that adds the tests. Lowering one is also a reviewable diff — state why in the commit message.
establishedBy: PR CI run 19 (run id 30431556718), artifacts `evidence-unit-coverage` / `evidence-security-matrix` / `evidence-integration-tests`, files `test-totals-unit.json`, `test-totals-database.json`, `test-totals-backend.json`, at feature head 8d7bfff09cf914e00ff5ff4587341ece261185c3, started 2026-07-29T07:24:48Z, GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest. All three tiers now carry a hosted measurement; none is a local or carried-over figure.
enforcementNote: Only `minTests` is enforced — summarise-vitest.mjs fails a tier that runs fewer. `measured` is provenance: it records what the named run actually observed, so a later reader can see how much headroom a floor had when it was set.

unit.note: Raised from 1000 to 1050. Run 19 measured 1082 on a hosted runner, replacing the local 1024 that established the old floor. The floor keeps roughly 30 tests of headroom for ordinary churn while no longer sitting 82 below the real count, where it could have absorbed an entire deleted test file without complaint.

database.note: Unchanged. Run 19 re-measured 1624, identical to the P1-21 hosted figure the floor was set against, so there is nothing to correct.

backend.note: Unchanged. Run 19 re-measured 1380, identical to the P1-21 hosted figure, including the four H6 regression tests.

web.note: RAISED to 2500 by the P1-28 integration wave, which merged the six screen waves, the security, QA and devops streams and the refuter remediation into one head and then re-measured the union — something no stream had done, and the reason three gates were red on the merge commit. The raise is FORCED, not chosen, twice over. `WTF-08` refuses a floor beneath cases that physically exist and the tier now DECLARES 2087 cases across 98 files; `WTF-09` refuses a headroom wider than the largest file in the tree, which declares 84 (`api-client.test.ts`), so the floor may not sit more than 84 below the measurement. Those two bound it to [2497, 2580] and 2500 is the round number inside that window. The previous pair, 2295 over a measured 2375, described a 91-file tree that no longer exists: the merged head runs 2581. `measured` and `measuredFiles` move with the floor so that all three describe ONE run. TRACEABILITY, kept rather than dropped: the last HOSTED measurement this line of figures descends from is 1867, taken on PR #214 by GitHub-hosted run 31514783205, job 93857184798 (`Web quality / web-quality`, artifact `evidence-web-quality`, file `test-totals-web.json`). Everything since is LOCAL and says so — see `measurementProvenance`.
web.whatTheHeadroomGuarantees: THE FLOOR DETECTS ANY NET LOSS OF MORE THAN 81 EXECUTED TESTS. That is measured (2581) minus the floor (2500), stated as the bound it actually is and recomputed from those two numbers rather than remembered. The largest web test file declares 84 cases and EXECUTES 132 (`api-client.test.ts` — `it.each` is one declaration and many cases), so the headroom sits below both and deleting that file trips the floor. Both tensions are satisfied: headroom above 0, so the floor is not a transcript of its own run, and below the largest file, so the deletion guarantee holds.
web.measuredFilesNote: `measuredFiles` is 98 — physical `*.test.ts`/`*.test.tsx` files under `apps/web/tests`, matching the tier as this branch holds it, and moved with `measured` so the two describe one run. It read 379 once, because `summarise()` populated it from `numTotalTestSuites`, which vitest sets to every `describe` block recursively. `measuredSuites` is retained so a reader comparing against an older artifact can see which number changed meaning rather than assuming the tier shrank.
web.measurementProvenance: LOCAL, and weaker than a hosted figure. 2581 is what `node scripts/ci/check-p1-27-closing-values.mjs --record web` observed on this branch on the P1-28 integration head: 98 files, 2581 executed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 todo, recorded in `docs/phase-1/phase-1-27/evidence/local-run-ledger.json` with the commit it was taken at. That ledger — not this field — is the authority a test reads, and it expires the moment any executable path changes, which is what stops this number outliving the tree it describes. The previous version of this field cited a run at 55a24ca0dd3e973ba381f78c9631e8d207928e78 taken against a 91-file tree; this branch has rewritten that ledger since, so citing it here would have been citing a record that no longer says what the citation claimed. WHAT REPLACES IT: the next HOSTED `Web quality / web-quality` run of this branch, whose `test-totals-web.json` is the figure QA-005 binds — exactly as the P1-27 hosted measurement replaced the local 1586 before it. TRACEABILITY of the last HOSTED measurement this line of figures descends from, kept rather than dropped: 1867, established at 424e5d884ed7c8f608c446408743cbf88ac80515 by GitHub-hosted run 31508526699, job 93836261711, and re-confirmed at 03e84f1f244252903569619de72481f30238e76a by run 31514783205, job 93857184798 (`Web quality / web-quality`, artifact `evidence-web-quality`, file `test-totals-web.json`). It measured a 70-file tree and could not be kept beside a floor above it. The figure standing here has NO run id, because it has no hosted run — that absence is the whole content of the LOCAL label, and it is why this field names the superseded run rather than pretending to name a current one.

unitFloorCaveat: The unit floor is deliberately NOT set to the measurement of the run that carries this commit. This change adds twenty tests — eight in tests/ci/dependency-path-proof.test.ts (AR-49), four in the workflow-security rule-registry suite (AR-50), four in tests/ci/baseline-integrity.test.ts covering the baselines established here, and four in tests/ci/documented-counts.test.ts (AR-51) — so the final head measures 1102, not the 1082 recorded above. Setting 1102 as the floor would make it a transcript of the last run rather than a guard, and every future commit would have to move it. 1050 is the guard; 1082 stays as the provenance of run 19. Note that this sentence is itself the kind of hand-written count AR-51 was about, which is why the floor and the provenance figure — the two values anything actually reads — are measured rather than narrated.
